spec_coverage.notes: GUARD COMPLETENESS (independent hunt, did NOT trust the spec's §6.1 table): grepped app/, lib/, config/, script/, bin/ for CreateAiSummaryGeneration, CreateBulkAiSummaryGeneration, GenerateAiJobApplicationSummaryJob, BulkGenerateAiSummariesJob, QueueBulkAiSummaryJobs, generate_ai_summary_with_credit_flow, AiJobApplicationAction::Orchestrate, ScoreJobApplication, and all direct AiJobApplicationSummary creators (AiJobApplicationSummary.create / ai_job_application_summaries.build). Every path that can start a NEW review is covered: (1) manual single -- ai_job_application_summaries_controller.rb:8 calls ValidateAiSummaryGeneration (guard at validate_ai_summary_generation.rb:30) before CreateAiSummaryGeneration; (2) bulk create/all_stages -- both actions pass job: @job (bulk controller :18/:44) into QueueBulkAiSummaryJobs whose guard (queue_bulk_ai_summary_jobs.rb:19) fires BEFORE the rescore_requested branch (:37), so rescore does NOT bypass it; per-record backstop at bulk_generate_ai_summaries_job.rb:61 (ValidateAiSummaryGeneration) plus the funnel guard; (3)/(4) auto paths -- job_application.rb:186 (after_commit enqueue_new_job_application, job_application.rb:46) and job_applications_controller.rb:118 both route through ValidateAutoAiSummaryGeneration (guard at validate_auto_ai_summary_generation.rb:20); (5) textract completion after_commit queue_ai_summary_job -- both branches call ValidateAiSummaryGeneration (textract_result.rb:132, :146); (6) AiJobCriteria#resume_waiting_summaries (ai_job_criteria.rb:39) is unguarded per spec; I adversarially constructed the interleaving where its 'guard is definitionally false' rationale fails (older pending row A succeeds AFTER newer row B zero-criteria-fails; predicate is TRUE when the resume fires) and confirmed the enqueued GenerateAiJobApplicationSummaryJob is blocked at the funnel guard, leaving summaries in awaiting_job_criteria (revivable, strictly better than the §6.4-documented pending-stranding) -- behavior stays inside the spec's documented-consequence envelope; (7) funnel guard present at textract_result.rb:70, after the succeeded-summary early return (:68) and BEFORE extract_job_criteria_if_needed (:72) exactly per §6.2.4. Orchestrate is instantiated ONLY at textract_result.rb:115 (private generate_ai_summary, called only from the guarded funnel at :78). Admin/ and cypress/ controllers: zero AI-summary triggers (grepped). Rake tasks: ai_scoring*.rake / ai_bulk_extract.rake are operator benchmark/backfill tools calling prompt classes directly; ai_bulk_extract.rake:34 does create AiJobApplicationSummary rows directly bypassing all guards, but it is pre-existing develop code untouched by this diff, runs Call-1 extraction only (never scoring), and is currently inert -- it assigns enum values :in_progress/:extracted that do not exist in the AiJobApplicationSummary status enum (pending/textract_processing/extracting/summarizing/awaiting_job_criteria/scoring/integrating/succeeded/retrying/failed), so it raises ArgumentError on the first record before any AI call; not diff scope, no finding. recurring_tasks.rake retrigger_stuck_pending_criteria re-enqueues ExtractJobCriteriaJob with one positional arg -- valid against the new optional-positional signature (adjudicated flag 4); note it inherently drops the requesting_organization_user_id for stuck user-requested rows (no completion toast on scheduler-recovered extractions) but the task is pre-existing, outside the diff. ExtractJobCriteriaJob signature/rescues/broadcast sites match SPEC §7 including the adjudicated fresh-read broadcast_completion and exhaustion-block row-exists gate; nil requesting id degrades to no-broadcast via OrganizationUser.find_by(id: nil). CONTROLLER ORDER (§5.2): ai_job_criteria_controller.rb matches the spec block verbatim; order exists -> authorize -> Flipper -> blank description -> extract -> render_one confirmed; every rejection path renders exactly once (exists renders and does not yield on miss; Pundit::NotAuthorizedError -> single 403 via ApplicationController rescue_from; each render_general_errors is followed by an explicit return which exits #create from inside the exists block; no render precedes authorize). current_organization_user (base_controller.rb:27 -> User belongs_to :current_organization_user, optional) cannot be nil at line 25: every JobPolicy#update_ai_settings? acceptance route (AiJobApplicationSummaryPolicy#can_use_ai_credits? -> is_org_admin?/is_org_user? in ApplicationPolicy) safe-navigates user.current_organization_user and returns false -> 403 when nil, and a nil record would already have crashed current_organization.jobs in exists (app-wide pre-existing pattern). GET show ungated by Flipper per §9; authorize job, :show? matches. SERIALIZER TRUTH TABLE (§5.3): serializer matches the spec block verbatim; independently re-derived all six states from the SQL: latest_ai_job_criteria (job.rb:688, order created_at desc) and latest_succeeded_ai_job_criteria (job.rb:692, status_succeeded + order created_at desc) use the SAME ordering column, so 'latest succeeded' can never diverge from 'latest row that succeeded' via created_at/updated_at skew (both methods pre-existing on develop, unchanged by the diff); never-ran yields nil/nil/nil/nil (safe-nav chain returns nil, no fabricated false); in-flight rows yield zero_criteria_failure false (status_failed? false); zero-criteria discrimination is exact-string via constants now substituted at all three writer sites (extract_criteria.rb:62,:122; score_job_application.rb:43 -- diff confirms identical strings, so historical rows written with the old literals still match); succeeded rows always have >=1 criterion (extract_criteria.rb non_duplicates.empty? guard before the succeeded update); the succeeded-with-blank-criteria conversion in ScoreJobApplication writes :failed + EMPTY_ARRAY onto @job.latest_ai_job_criteria (the latest row), keeping the predicate truthful. N+1: 4 queries per render (2x latest, 2x latest_succeeded), all on indexed ai_job_criteria.job_id (db/schema.rb:189), single-record endpoint -- acceptable. RACE (§4.1): two rapid POSTs create rows A then B (no pending guard, documented consequence -- not flagged per brief). ExtractCriteria is constructed with ai_job_criteria_id and every status/criteria write in extract_criteria.rb goes through @ai_job_criteria (found by that id) -- it never resolves job.latest_ai_job_criteria -- so the job on the OLDER row can never overwrite the NEWER row's status; ExtractJobCriteriaJob likewise operates only on its own arguments.first row in perform, StandardError rescue, and retry_on exhaustion. Latest-row-wins holds everywhere that matters: serializer status reads B, ScoreJobApplication and the review guard read latest (B), and A's late success firing resume_waiting_summaries is blocked at the funnel when B is zero-failed. Both broadcasts fire (two toasts possible) -- inside the documented 'wasteful but harmless' envelope. Adjudicated rulings honored: no re-flag of the kwarg, third message, failure broadcast, positional args, display precedence, claim-row fix (bulk_generate_ai_summaries_job.rb:62-66 matches §6.3 + conventions-pass logger line), optional job input, or the idempotent no-result-branch create.
